message.content: {"id":"i3","meaning_zh":"指摆放在蓝白条纹瓷盘中的菠萝鸡翅，是这桌丰盛家常餐食里的一道主菜，鸡翅裹着亮泽的红烧酱汁，搭配切块菠萝，表面撒有葱花与白芝麻提香。","examples":[{"en":"I tried a new recipe for braised chicken wings with pineapple tonight—the sweet tang of the pineapple cut through the rich sauce perfectly.","zh":"我今晚试做了一道新菜——菠萝鸡翅，菠萝的清甜刚好中和了浓郁酱汁的厚重感。"},{"en":"Back during Lunar New Year at home, my mom would always make braised chicken wings with pineapple as one of the signature dishes for our family reunion dinner.","zh":"以前在家过农历新年的时候，我妈总会把菠萝鸡翅作为团圆饭的招牌菜之一。"}],"usage_note_zh":""}

parsed_json.meaning_zh: 指摆放在蓝白条纹瓷盘中的菠萝鸡翅，是这桌丰盛家常餐食里的一道主菜，鸡翅裹着亮泽的红烧酱汁，搭配切块菠萝，表面撒有葱花与白芝麻提香。

examples.en: I tried a new recipe for braised chicken wings with pineapple tonight—the sweet tang of the pineapple cut through the rich sauce perfectly.
examples.zh: 我今晚试做了一道新菜——菠萝鸡翅，菠萝的清甜刚好中和了浓郁酱汁的厚重感。

examples.en: Back during Lunar New Year at home, my mom would always make braised chicken wings with pineapple as one of the signature dishes for our family reunion dinner.
examples.zh: 以前在家过农历新年的时候，我妈总会把菠萝鸡翅作为团圆饭的招牌菜之一。
